What would we do if we didn’t have such beautiful music to listen to, what  a sad world it would be. How lucky we have been to have had composers able to bring us such wonderful music. I am 91 and I cry when I hear music like this, not because I am sad or depressed,just grateful there were people able and competent enough to write such wonderful Melodie’s.It brings back both sad and wonderful memories.Im afraid today’s music does not have the same effect. I still parlay my piano and sometimes I cry doing that. How lucky am I that I am still able to play,I’ve arthritic hands and can’t move easily,Ì can’t dress myself easily, I can’t write easily but I still play. I think I’ve been very lucky. My grand children stand behind me whilst I play and sing along with the music.

Thank you so much for sharing this beautiful story. ❤️ At 91, the fact that you still sit at the piano, play, and sing while your grandchildren stand behind you is truly precious. Music has a way of carrying our memories through every chapter of life.

Your words remind us that music isn't simply something we listen to — it becomes part of who we are. And the fact that you still play despite everything you've been through is incredibly inspiring.

What a beautiful gift you are giving your grandchildren: memories they will carry with them for the rest of their lives. ❤️
